items.label: cannot read
items.why: A binary test fixture (an image or PDF the tests read), not test code. It sits under test/, so it is a test path, and its content cannot be read, so it is flagged rather than passed. A reviewer would call this noise.

items.label: false alarm
items.why: Each "set +e" step saves the gate's exit code (code=$?), stamps a receipt and then fails with "exit $code"; each "continue-on-error: true" runs a must-fail negative control whose failure the next step checks. Nothing is ignored. The rule has no pattern for a saved and re-raised exit code.
